channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from summarizedStoriesMainNLscienceAndDiscovery, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Scientists Find Major Brain Shift Between Ages 50 and 75
item.description: Scientists have uncovered sweeping changes in how the human brain controls and organizes its genome beginning in midlife, offering new clues about aging.

item.title: Australian Cave Held 25,000 Years of Ritual Secrets
item.description: Microscopic plant remains reveal how GunaiKurnai ancestors used Cloggs Cave for ritual practices over thousands of years, with people deliberately gathering plants.

item.title: Chocolate scent linked to more reps with less fatigue
item.description: Smelling chocolate allowed men to perform more leg extensions without increased exertion, with dark chocolate showing a stronger effect.

item.title: UV light uncovers possible camouflage on ancient crocodile fossil
item.description: A 125-million-year-old crocodile fossil preserved skin, possible sensory organs, respiratory structures, and unexpected features.
